Write about the importance of taking regular breaks at work in order to stay focused and maintain energy levels. Take the time to plan 10 or 15 minutes of time to take a step away from your computer, pick up a pen and paper, and write down what's on your mind. Doing this can help reduce stress levels and likely increase productivity in the long-term. Taking frequent breaks also helps you stay focused and prevents "burn-out" which can come from working long hours without rest. Making breaks a priority allows an individual to remain alert, alert and maintain proper focus on the task at hand. Taking regular breaks also helps to increase creativity by allowing an individual to clear their head and come back to a task with a temporary fresh perspective. Regular breaks also helps to keep stress levels in check, so having this form of time available can be beneficial to both employer and employee.
